title: Stop waiting for the battle to get easier. It won’t.
paragraphs: Stop waiting for the battle to get easier. It won’t.

The enemy thrives on your complacency. As long as you are comfortable, quiet, and still, you are not a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Growth, breakthrough, and victory only happen when you step out of the boat and onto the battlefield.
It’s time to leave the playground and pick up your sword. Are you ready to get uncomfortable for the Gospel? 🔥
📖 "For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control." – 2 Timothy 1:7
